disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与脚本中的密钥与凭据痕迹：未发现硬编码密钥，未发现读取 dsh 凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据等敏感路径的代码。
checked_items.en: Examined all source code and scripts for traces of secrets and credentials: no hardcoded secrets found, no code reading sensitive paths such as dsh credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器与桌面观测对密码输入框做了遮蔽处理，密码值不会进入模型可见的观测文本。
checked_items.en: Browser and desktop observation masks password input fields; password values do not enter the model-visible observation text.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取 dsh 凭据文件、SSH 私钥等敏感路径的代码；观测结果中的密码字段被统一替换为占位文本，不进入模型可见文本。
evidence.en: No code reading sensitive paths such as dsh credential files or SSH private keys found; password fields in observation results are uniformly replaced with placeholder text and do not enter model-visible text.

checked_items.zh: 逐一审查了两个注册工具的描述文本与注入系统提示片段：均为正常功能说明与安全提示（明确把界面文本标记为不可信数据），无指令覆写、系统消息伪装或诱导安装措辞（机械命中 DSH-T02 的提示片段为良性内容）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the description text and injected system prompt snippets of the two registered tools one by one: they are all normal functional descriptions and security tips (explicitly marking UI text as untrusted data), with no instruction override, system message disguise, or installation-inducing wording (the snippet mechanically flagged by DSH-T02 is benign content).

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现面向 Agent 的指令文件（如 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md 等），README、文档与站点脚本中未发现注入措辞。
checked_items.en: No Agent-oriented instruction files (e.g., AGENTS.md, SKILL.md) found in the entire tree; no injected wording found in README, documentation, or site scripts.

evidence.zh: 两个注册工具的描述与注入系统提示（DSH-T02 命中）为正常功能说明，并明确把界面/OCR 文本标为不可信数据，未发现指令覆写或隐藏意图。
evidence.en: The descriptions and injected system prompts of the two registered tools (flagged by DSH-T02) are normal functional explanations and explicitly mark UI/OCR text as untrusted data; no instruction override or hidden intent found.

evidence.zh: 工具描述不含诱导安装或改写配置的措辞；安装插件只发生在用户手动点击 macOS 设置界面按钮时。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions contain no wording that induces installation or configuration changes; plugin installation only occurs when the user manually clicks a button in the macOS settings interface.

checked_items.zh: 机械扫描 12 处命中全部人工复核：挂载配置中的 JS 表达式（DSH-P01）仅为取插件状态目录的良性调用；安装钩子（DSH-X02）仅做 TypeScript 编译；构建/发布/冒烟脚本（DSH-X03）为开发期工具；三个 CI 工作流（DSH-X07）为标准测试、发布与文档发布流程，均无外联、凭据读取或隐蔽下载执行。
checked_items.en: All 12 mechanical scan hits were manually reviewed: the JS expression in the patch config (DSH-P01) is only a benign call to get the plugin state directory; the install hook (DSH-X02) only performs TypeScript compilation; build/publish/smoke scripts (DSH-X03) are development-time tools; the three CI workflows (DSH-X07) are standard testing, publishing, and documentation-publishing flows, none with outbound connections, credential reads, or hidden downloads.

checked_items.zh: 运行时代码未发现动态执行构造；唯一的子进程调用是拉起本地原生助手（系统 open 命令）。
checked_items.en: No dynamic execution constructs found in runtime code; the only subprocess call is launching the local native helper (system open command).

evidence.zh: 挂载配置中的 JS 表达式（DSH-P01 命中 cordis.patch.yml:8）仅为取用户 home 下插件状态目录的良性调用，未携带任意执行载荷；仓库内无其他 patch 文件。
evidence.en: The JS expression in the patch config (DSH-P01 hit at cordis.patch.yml:8) is only a benign call to get the plugin state directory under the user's home; it carries no arbitrary execution payload; no other patch files exist in the repository.

evidence.zh: 未调用宿主动态执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run），未发现把模型代码放进宿主进程执行的路径。
evidence.en: No calls to host dynamic execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run); no path discovered that runs model code inside the host process.

evidence.zh: 安装钩子（DSH-X02）仅为 TypeScript 编译；构建/发布/冒烟脚本（DSH-X03）与 CI 工作流（DSH-X07）均为开发期工程实现，无远程加载执行、凭据读取或隐蔽下载。
evidence.en: The install hook (DSH-X02) only performs TypeScript compilation; build/publish/smoke scripts (DSH-X03) and CI workflows (DSH-X07) are all development-time engineering implementations, with no remote loading execution, credential reads, or hidden downloads.

evidence.zh: 插件未声明 dsh.client，无浏览器侧客户端模块加载面，本场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not declare dsh.client; there is no browser-side client module loading surface; this scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 宿主与原生助手的运行时代码未发现任何出站网络调用或外部端点配置。
checked_items.en: No outbound network calls or external endpoint configurations found in the runtime code of the host and native helper.

checked_items.zh: 产品站脚本（docs/app.js）的 GitHub API 请求、键盘监听与剪贴板写入（DSH-X05 命中）属站点复制/导航功能，不随插件运行；未发现凭据读取与网络外联的组合。
checked_items.en: The GitHub API requests, keyboard listening, and clipboard writes in the product site script (docs/app.js) (flagged by DSH-X05) belong to site copy/navigation functionality and do not run with the plugin; no combination of credential reading and network outbound connections found.

evidence.zh: 宿主与原生助手运行时代码无任何出站网络调用，不存在凭据外发通道；产品站脚本对 GitHub API 的请求不随插件运行。
evidence.en: The host and native helper runtime code has no outbound network calls; no channel for credential exfiltration exists; the product site script's requests to the GitHub API do not run with the plugin.

checked_items.zh: 依赖为官方 deepseek-ai 系列包与 playwright-core，未发现名称仿冒、可疑安装脚本或浮动 git 引用；发布与签名/公证流程在 CI 中为常规实现。
checked_items.en: Dependencies are official deepseek-ai packages and playwright-core; no name spoofing, suspicious install scripts, or floating git references found; the publishing and signing/notarization flows in CI are conventional implementations.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置只插入本插件的主机与工具行，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行；首次审计无版本基线，无法做升级行为比对。

evidence.en: The patch config only inserts this plugin's lines and does not touch configuration lines related to sandbox, approval, or permissions; there are no disable switches or environment variable privilege-reduction patterns.

evidence.zh: 未发现对工具执行前、审批请求等安全事件的高优先级监听，不存在截断审批链的代码。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners for security events such as pre-tool execution or approval requests found; no code that truncates the approval chain exists.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本可比较升级行为，本场景不适用。
evidence.en: First audit; no previous version to compare upgrade behavior against; this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection or interception configurations.

checked_items.zh: 审查了运行架构：宿主通过子进程拉起原生助手，经 Unix 域套接字 RPC 通信；该套接字服务无客户端认证，任何同用户进程可连接并下发桌面控制命令（FND-001）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the runtime architecture: the host launches the native helper via a subprocess and communicates over a Unix domain socket RPC; this socket service has no client authentication, and any process of the same user can connect and issue desktop control commands (FND-001).

checked_items.zh: 辅助功能与屏幕录制权限由用户在 macOS 系统设置中显式授予，插件不修改系统授权数据库；未做动态沙箱验证。
checked_items.en: Accessibility and screen recording permissions are explicitly granted by the user in macOS System Settings; the plugin does not modify the system authorization database; no dynamic sandbox verification was performed.

evidence.zh: 插件启动了一个本机监听服务（Unix 域套接字），该服务无客户端认证，任何同用户进程可连接并下发桌面控制与观测命令，详见 FND-001。
evidence.en: The plugin starts a local listening service (Unix domain socket) without client authentication; any process of the same user can connect and issue desktop control and observation commands; see FND-001 for details.

title.zh: 原生助手的本地套接字服务缺少客户端认证
title.en: The native helper's local socket service lacks client authentication

description.zh:
插件启动时通过系统命令拉起一个原生 macOS 助手进程，并用 Unix 域套接字与之通信（src/native/client.ts:243 传入 --socket 路径；配置默认在用户 home 下的 .dsh/computer-use/native-agent.sock，见 src/config.ts:38）。

助手端监听该套接字并处理任何连接：仅校验协议版本号，不校验客户端身份，收到合法 JSON 请求即执行观察桌面、点击、键入、启动应用、按键等命令（native/macos-helper/Sources/DSHComputerUseCore/Agent/ComputerUseAgent.swift:35 的请求分发；套接字文件权限为仅属主可读写，见 native/macos-helper/Sources/DSHComputerUseCore/Transport/UnixSocketServer.swift:44）。

套接字路径位于用户 home 下且可预测，任何以同一用户身份运行的本机进程都能连接并发起命令。
description.en:
At startup, the plugin uses a system command to launch a native macOS helper process and communicates with it via a Unix domain socket (src/native/client.ts:243 passes the --socket path; the default configuration is .dsh/computer-use/native-agent.sock under the user's home, see src/config.ts:38).

The helper listens on this socket and processes any connection: it only validates the protocol version, not the client identity, and executes commands such as observing the desktop, clicking, typing, launching applications, and key presses upon receiving valid JSON requests (request dispatch at native/macos-helper/Sources/DSHComputerUseCore/Agent/ComputerUseAgent.swift:35; the socket file is readable/writable only by the owner, see native/macos-helper/Sources/DSHComputerUseCore/Transport/UnixSocketServer.swift:44).

The socket path is under the user's home and predictable; any local process running as the same user can connect and issue commands.

evidence.zh:
src/config.ts:38 — helperSocketPath 默认取 stateDir 下的 native-agent.sock（stateDir 默认 ~/.dsh/computer-use，由 cordis.patch.yml:8 以 dshHomePath('computer-use') 设定）。
src/native/client.ts:243 — 以 /usr/bin/open -gjn <app> --args --agent --socket <path> 拉起助手。
native/macos-helper/Sources/DSHComputerUseCore/Transport/UnixSocketServer.swift:44 — chmod(path, S_IRUSR | S_IWUSR) 后监听。
native/macos-helper/Sources/DSHComputerUseCore/Agent/ComputerUseAgent.swift:35 — handleMethod 对任意连接分发 performDesktop、observeDesktop、ocrFile 等方法。
evidence.en:
src/config.ts:38 — helperSocketPath defaults to native-agent.sock under stateDir (stateDir defaults to ~/.dsh/computer-use, set by cordis.patch.yml:8 via dshHomePath('computer-use')).
src/native/client.ts:243 — launches the helper with /usr/bin/open -gjn <app> --args --agent --socket <path>.
native/macos-helper/Sources/DSHComputerUseCore/Transport/UnixSocketServer.swift:44 — listens after chmod(path, S_IRUSR | S_IWUSR).
native/macos-helper/Sources/DSHComputerUseCore/Agent/ComputerUseAgent.swift:35 — handleMethod dispatches methods such as performDesktop, observeDesktop, and ocrFile to any connection.

impact.zh:
后果：同一用户下任何未经辅助功能/屏幕录制授权的恶意或不受信进程，都能连接该套接字，借用助手已获授权的桌面控制与屏幕捕获能力进行点击、键入、启动应用、读取界面文本与截屏，形成对 macOS 按应用授权机制的绕过；反向也可由同用户进程抢占套接字冒充助手，向宿主返回伪造的界面观测。

触发条件：助手在正常使用中持续监听；攻击者只需以同一用户身份运行进程并连接可预测的套接字路径，无需改动插件任何文件。

定级依据：未发现插件自身有恶意证据，但该本地 RPC 缺少双向认证，滥用路径在正常运行条件下真实可达，按中危收录；若未来出现利用该通道的实际外泄行为，应升级处理。
impact.en:
Consequences: Any malicious or untrusted process running as the same user, even without Accessibility/Screen Recording authorization, can connect to this socket and, borrowing the helper's already-authorized desktop control and screen capture capabilities, perform clicks, typing, application launches, reading UI text, and screenshots, thereby bypassing macOS's per-app authorization mechanism; conversely, a same-user process can also preempt the socket to impersonate the helper and return forged UI observations to the host.

Trigger condition: The helper listens continuously during normal use; the attacker only needs to run a process as the same user and connect to the predictable socket path, without modifying any plugin files.

Severity basis: No malicious evidence was found in the plugin itself, but this local RPC lacks mutual authentication, and the abuse path is realistically reachable under normal operating conditions; it is recorded as medium severity; if actual exfiltration via this channel emerges in the future, it should be escalated.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：dsh 声明结构有效，依赖均为官方包，无名称仿冒。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the dsh declaration structure is valid, dependencies are all official packages, and no name spoofing.

summary.en: Static scan completed: all 12 mechanical hits were manually reviewed and confirmed to be benign engineering implementations, not constituting malicious payloads.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：运行时代码无外联、无凭据读取、无混淆载荷；安装钩子仅为编译步骤。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: runtime code has no outbound connections, no credential reads, and no obfuscated payloads; the install hook is just a compilation step.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述与系统提示片段无注入措辞，能力声明与实测一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool descriptions and system prompt snippets have no injection wording, and capability claims are consistent with actual measurements.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（未提供动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification performed (no dynamic observation artifacts provided).

limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification performed (no dynamic observation artifacts); first audit, no baseline version for comparison; the plugin does not provide an explicit capability declaration list, so network/command-line/file-system capabilities are inferred from code measurements; docs/app.js belongs to the product display site script, and the plugin does not declare dsh.client, so it is not part of the plugin loading surface.
